newsitem.title: QATAR: TENNIS-ENQVIST OUT IN OPENING ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ENQVIST OUT IN OPENING ROUND.

text.p: Second seed Thomas Enqvist crashed 6-4 7-5 to fellow Swede Magnus Larsson in the $635,000 Qatar Open first round on Monday.
Larsson now faces compatriot Patrik Fredriksson, who defeated Moroccan Karim Alami 6-2 6-2.
The elimination of world nunber nine Enqvist was another setback for tournament organisers, who had already lost top Boris Becker and Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek through injury.
Enqvist arrived on the back of successive victories in Paris and Stockholm during November.
"I have been suffering from a virus recently and so I haven't played much," he said. "But Magnus deserved to win. On his day he can beat anyone."
Fifth seed Magnus Gustafsson kept the Swedish flag flying with a 4-6 6-1 6-4 triumph over Jordi Burillo of Spain. Britain's Tim Henman defeated Austrian qualifier Herbert Wiltschnig 6-3 6-2.
Top seed Thomas Muster opens his campaign on Tuesday against Hernan Gumy of Argentina.
